lesson.subject: social_studies

misconceptionProbe.signal: Ava thinks only famous people help.
misconceptionProbe.checkPrompt: Can a neighbor help the park as much as a famous leader?
misconceptionProbe.expectedConfusion: Believing impact requires fame or a title.

blocks.title: Nature Heroes
blocks.prompt: Meet people who help our parks and animals stay safe and clean.

blocks.title: Helping Hands
blocks.prompt: Leaders solve big problems. Volunteers do kind work for free to help others.

blocks.title: Match the Helper
blocks.prompt: Match the person to the way they help nature.

blocks.title: Your Turn
blocks.prompt: If you pick up trash at the beach, are you making a difference?

blocks.title: Lesson Recap
blocks.prompt: Ava learned how individuals improve their community through nature-focused actions.

sceneSpec.title: Town Fixer
sceneSpec.instruction: Pick a town problem, then send the best helper team.
sceneSpec.helperText: Match the problem to the team that knows how to fix it.
sceneSpec.rewardFact: Different helpers in a town do different jobs to keep people safe.
sceneSpec.startMessage: Choose a town problem first, then send the right team.
sceneSpec.mismatchMessage: That team is not the best match. Try another helper team.

problems.label: Road pothole
problems.fact: Road crews fix streets so travel stays safer.

problems.label: Dark street corner
problems.fact: Light crews keep public lights working at night.

problems.label: Cat in a tree
problems.fact: Emergency helpers jump in when a rescue is needed.

hintLadder.text: Look at the picture of the person holding a seedling.
Does planting a tree help the air or the sidewalk more?
A park ranger protects trees. Who might protect the ocean?

lesson.parentSummary: Ava explored how ordinary people and leaders protect nature to improve their community.
